description: This file defines a PHP class LeavePeriodModel that implements the Normalizable interface. It is part of the OrangeHRM Leave plugin's API model layer and represents a data model for leave periods, initialized with a LeavePeriod DTO. The class uses traits for serialization and mapping of entity attributes to API response schema. It is likely used to serialize leave period data for API responses, including start and end date properties.

classes.name: LeavePeriodModel
classes.description: A PHP class representing a leave period in the API model layer, serializable for API responses by mapping properties from the LeavePeriod DTO.
